_about: Prototype 'visitors': real people from the Seamless Interaction dataset (Meta, 2025, CC BY-NC 4.0, naturalistic/dev split), each a 23-38 s segment chosen because the person mentions an animal. Ground truth was annotated by hand from the video and the dataset's own transcript (not from our pipeline). 'calibration_db' = median speech level of that recording vendor's setup (booth-calibration analogue). Glasses were verified on full-resolution face crops for all visitors.
